description: FR3 refers to the roughly 7–24 GHz spectrum between today's sub-6 GHz bands and mmWave. It offers additional bandwidth with more favorable propagation than higher mmWave bands and is considered an important spectrum expansion for 6G.

featured.title: Varactor Controlled X-Band Passive RIS Optimization
featured.authors: H. Zadorozhnyi, F.-N. Stapelfeldt, D. Vasylenko, und V. Issakov
featured.summary: Optimizes “Varactor Controlled X-Band Passive RIS Optimization”. Focus: resource decisions, constraints and performance trade-offs in FR3 Spectrum (7-24 GHz), giving a quick view of the problem and its role in future wireless and network systems.

publications.authors: A. Engelhardt, F. Stapelfeldt, M. Kadam, P. Oliveira, H.-D. Wohlmuth, und V. Issakov
publications.summary: Investigates “A Highly-Integrated 64-QAM Ku-Band Transceiver in SiGe BiCMOS for 6G Cell-Free MIMO”. Focus: the core mechanism, system behavior and engineering implications in FR3 Spectrum (7-24 GHz), giving a quick view of the problem and its role in future wireless and network systems.
